name: refactor_php_if_elseif_to_match
description: Refactors an if/elseif log-level severity lookup into a PHP 8 match expression
prompts: LogLevel::severityFor(string $level): int in src/LogLevel.php maps a log level name to a numeric severity using an if/elseif chain with strict (===) string comparisons: "debug" -> 0, "info" -> 1, "warning" -> 2, "error" -> 3, "critical" -> 4, any other string -> -1. Refactor it to use PHP 8's `match` expression instead of if/elseif. Do not change observable behavior: all five known levels must map to the same severities, and an unknown level (e.g. "trace") must still return -1. Keep the class name and the severityFor(string): int signature.

setup_files.src/LogLevel.php:
<?php
namespace App;

class LogLevel
{
    public static function severityFor(string $level): int
    {
        if ($level === "debug") {
            return 0;
        } elseif ($level === "info") {
            return 1;
        } elseif ($level === "warning") {
            return 2;
        } elseif ($level === "error") {
            return 3;
        } elseif ($level === "critical") {
            return 4;
        } else {
            return -1;
        }
    }
}

test_setup_files.tests/RefactorHiddenTest.php:
<?php
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

require_once __DIR__ . '/../src/LogLevel.php';

final class RefactorHiddenTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testKnownLevels(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame(0, \App\LogLevel::severityFor("debug"));
        $this->assertSame(1, \App\LogLevel::severityFor("info"));
        $this->assertSame(2, \App\LogLevel::severityFor("warning"));
        $this->assertSame(3, \App\LogLevel::severityFor("error"));
        $this->assertSame(4, \App\LogLevel::severityFor("critical"));
    }

    public function testUnknownLevel(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame(-1, \App\LogLevel::severityFor("trace"));
    }
}

reference_solution.src/LogLevel.php:
<?php
namespace App;

class LogLevel
{
    public static function severityFor(string $level): int
    {
        return match ($level) {
            "debug" => 0,
            "info" => 1,
            "warning" => 2,
            "error" => 3,
            "critical" => 4,
            default => -1,
        };
    }
}
